title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin trades at sixty-four thousand two hundred twenty-two with whale accumulation accelerating as the Fed hits its rate ceiling. Further tightening is off the table, allowing miners and large holders to front-run the next move without interference. Marty Bent has connected these dots. The cycle reset forces long-term holders to choose exit or deeper custody, and stronger hands keep stacking through volatility as Andreas Antonopoulos has outlined.

Self-custody removes freeze threats entirely.
